# model type1
```{r}

# 准备Stan数据
data_df$SubID_stan <- as.integer(as.factor(data_df$SubID))

data_df$PE_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(data_df$PE))

stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(data_df),
  S = n_subjects,
  subject = data_df$SubID_stan,
  x = data_df$PE_scaled,
  y = data_df$alloc_var
)
```

```{r}
modelID_begin <- 19
modelID_end <- 22
model_files <- paste0("model_ascertain_", modelID_begin:modelID_end, "_260402.stan")


for (i in 1:(modelID_end - modelID_begin + 1)) {
  # message(paste("正在运行模型:", model_files[i])) # 增加进度提示
  
  sm <- stan_model(file = file.path(stan_dir, model_files[i]))
  model_output <- tryCatch({
    sampling(
      object = sm,
      data = stan_data,
      iter = 8000,          # 进一步增加迭代次数 (原 4000)
      warmup = 4000,        # 相应增加预热期
      chains = 4,       
      cores = 4,
      seed = 123,           # 固定随机种子，方便结果复现
      # 【加这一行！】告诉 Stan 剔除掉这三个巨型/冗余变量，只保存剩下的
      # pars = c("mu", "z_int", "z_slo"), 
      # include = FALSE,     # FALSE 表示“除了上面这几个，其他的我都要”
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95,   # 默认0.8，提高到0.95-0.99
                     max_treedepth = 15)   # 默认10，提高到12或15
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("模型", model_files[i], "运行失败:", e$message))
    return(NULL) # 出错时跳过，继续下一个
  })
  
  # 保存结果（建议在循环内保存，防止断电丢失）
  if (!is.null(model_output)) {
    output_file <- paste0("model_ascertain_EXP3_", modelID_begin + i - 1,  "_output_260318.Rdata")
    save(model_output, file = file.path(result_dir, output_file))
  }

  # 1. 提取 log_likelihood
  log_lik_mat <- loo::extract_log_lik(model_output, parameter_name = "log_lik")
  
  # 2. 准备链的信息 (假设你是 4 条链)
  n_chains <- 4 
  n_iter <- nrow(log_lik_mat) / n_chains
  chain_id <- rep(1:n_chains, each = n_iter)
  r_eff <- relative_eff(exp(log_lik_mat), chain_id = chain_id)
  
  # 3. 【这行是救命的关键】必须加上 save_psis = TRUE ！！！
  loo_result <- loo(log_lik_mat, r_eff = r_eff, save_psis = TRUE)
  
  # 4. 提取后验预测值
  y_rep_samples <- rstan::extract(model_output)$y_rep
  
  # 5. 画图！直接把存下来的 psis_object 塞进去
  p <- ppc_loo_pit_overlay(
    y = data_df$alloc_var, 
    yrep = y_rep_samples, 
    psis_object = loo_result$psis_object
  )
  
  print(p)
}

```

# R-hat
```{r}

output_file <- paste0("model_ascertain_EXP3_2_output_260410.Rdata")
load(file = paste0(result_dir, output_file))

# 1. 定义需要放进表格的核心参数名
target_pars <- c("mu_int_neg", "mu_int_pos", "mu_slo_neg", "mu_slo_pos", 
                 "sigma_int_neg", "sigma_int_pos", "sigma_slo_neg", "sigma_slo_pos", 
                 "sigma_obs", "nu")

# 2. 提取这些参数的 summary
table_data <- summary(model_output, pars = target_pars)$summary

# 3. 打印出方便填表的数据格式 (保留 3 位小数)
print(round(table_data[, c("mean", "sd", "2.5%", "97.5%", "n_eff", "Rhat")], 8))

# ==========================================
# 4. 顺便计算一下那句文字描述里需要的“最大个体 Rhat”
# 提取所有个体参数
ind_summary <- summary(model_output, pars = c("int_neg", "int_pos", "slo_neg", "slo_pos"))$summary
max_ind_rhat <- max(ind_summary[, "Rhat"], na.rm = TRUE)
cat("\n👉 填入文字段落的【最大个体 R-hat】值为:", round(max_ind_rhat, 4), "\n")

```



# LOOIC compare-1
```{r}
#Model weights
output_files <- paste0("model_ascertain_EXP3_", 1 : 22, "_output_260410.Rdata")

loo_list <- list()
r_eff_list <- list()

for (i in 1:length(output_files)) {
  
  load(file = paste0(result_dir, output_files[i]))
  
  log_lik <- extract_log_lik(model_output, parameter_name = "log_lik", merge_chains = FALSE)
  r_eff <- relative_eff(exp(log_lik), cores = 8)
  loo_list[[i]] <- loo(log_lik, r_eff = r_eff, save_psis = TRUE, cores = 8)
  
  r_eff_list[[i]] <- list(
    model = output_files[i],
    r_eff_summary = summary(r_eff),
    r_eff_min = min(r_eff),
    r_eff_max = max(r_eff),
    r_eff_median = median(r_eff)
  )
  
  rm(model_output, log_lik, r_eff)
}

names(loo_list) <- paste0("Model_", 1 : 22)

cat("=== 各模型的r_eff统计信息 ===\n")
for (i in 1:length(r_eff_list)) {
  cat("\n模型:", r_eff_list[[i]]$model, "\n")
  cat("最小值:", round(r_eff_list[[i]]$r_eff_min, 4), "\n")
  cat("最大值:", round(r_eff_list[[i]]$r_eff_max, 4), "\n")
  cat("中位数:", round(r_eff_list[[i]]$r_eff_median, 4), "\n")
}

model_weights <- loo_model_weights(loo_list, method = "stacking")

print(model_weights, digits=8)

#LOOIC
looic_comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = names(loo_list),
  elpd_loo = sapply(loo_list, function(x) x$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"]),
  se_elpd_loo = sapply(loo_list, function(x) x$estimates["elpd_loo", "SE"]),
  p_loo = sapply(loo_list, function(x) x$estimates["p_loo", "Estimate"]),
  se_p_loo = sapply(loo_list, function(x) x$estimates["p_loo", "SE"]),
  looic = sapply(loo_list, function(x) x$estimates["looic", "Estimate"]), 
  se_looic = sapply(loo_list, function(x) x$estimates["looic", "SE"])      
)

looic_comparison <- looic_comparison[order(looic_comparison$looic), ]
looic_comparison$Rank <- 1:nrow(looic_comparison)

best_looic <- min(looic_comparison$looic)
looic_comparison$looic_diff <- looic_comparison$looic - best_looic

looic_comparison$weight <- as.numeric(model_weights)[match(looic_comparison$Model, names(loo_list))]

cat("=== 所有模型LOOIC比较表 ===\n")
print(looic_comparison, row.names = FALSE, digits = 8)

```

# 模型综合性诊断
```{r}

check_convergence_phd <- function(fit, rhat_threshold = 1.1, 
                                  rhat_max_threshold = 1.05,
                                  ess_threshold = 400,
                                  hyper_regex = "mu|sigma|tau|beta|alpha") {
  
  summ <- summary(fit)$summary
  rhat <- summ[, "Rhat"]
  
  # ---------- 1️⃣ Divergent ----------
  sampler_params <- get_sampler_params(fit, inc_warmup = FALSE)
  n_divergent <- sum(sapply(sampler_params, function(x) sum(x[, "divergent__"])))
  
  # ---------- 2️⃣ Rhat ----------
  max_rhat <- max(rhat, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_bad_rhat <- sum(rhat > rhat_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ---------- 3️⃣ Hyper-parameters ----------
  hyper_idx <- grepl(hyper_regex, rownames(summ))
  hyper_rhat <- rhat[hyper_idx]
  max_hyper_rhat <- max(hyper_rhat, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ---------- 4️⃣ ESS ----------
  ess <- summ[, "n_eff"]
  min_ess <- min(ess, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_ess <- mean(ess, na.rm = TRUE)  # <--- 新增：计算 ESS 均值
  n_low_ess <- sum(ess < ess_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ---------- 输出 ----------
  cat("=====================================\n")
  cat("博士级 Stan 收敛诊断报告\n")
  cat("=====================================\n\n")
  
  cat("1️⃣ Divergent transitions:", n_divergent, "\n")
  if(n_divergent > 0) {
    cat("❌ 严重问题：存在 divergent transitions\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("✅ 无 divergent transitions\n\n")
  }
  
  cat("2️⃣ 最大 Rhat:", round(max_rhat, 4), "\n")
  cat("   Rhat >", rhat_threshold, "的参数数量:", n_bad_rhat, "\n")
  
  if(max_rhat > rhat_max_threshold) {
    cat("❌ 最大 Rhat 超过", rhat_max_threshold, "\n\n")
  } else if(max_rhat > rhat_threshold) {
    cat("⚠ 有轻微收敛问题\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("✅ Rhat 表现优秀\n\n")
  }
  
  cat("3️⃣ 超参数最大 Rhat:", round(max_hyper_rhat, 4), "\n")
  if(max_hyper_rhat > rhat_threshold) {
    cat("❌ 超参数未收敛（这是最关键问题）\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("✅ 超参数收敛良好\n\n")
  }
  
  # 在 check_convergence_phd 函数内的第 4 模块（ESS 部分）添加：
  
  # ---------- 4️⃣ ESS ----------
  ess <- summ[, "n_eff"]
  min_ess <- min(ess, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_ess <- mean(ess, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_low_ess <- sum(ess < ess_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # 获取 ESS 低于阈值的参数名称
  low_ess_params <- rownames(summ)[which(ess < ess_threshold)] # <--- 核心逻辑

  # ... 之前的输出代码 ...

  cat("4️⃣ ESS 统计:\n")
  cat("   最小 ESS:", round(min_ess, 1), "\n")
  cat("   平均 ESS:", round(mean_ess, 1), "\n")
  cat("   ESS <", ess_threshold, "的参数数量:", n_low_ess, "\n")
  
  # 新增：如果有低 ESS 参数，则打印出来
  if(n_low_ess > 0) {
    cat("   🚨 ESS 较低的参数名 (前10个): \n")
    print(head(low_ess_params, 10)) 
    if(n_low_ess > 10) cat("   ... 以及其他", n_low_ess - 10, "个参数。\n")
  }
  
  # ---------- 最终判断 ----------
  cat("=====================================\n")
  cat("🎓 综合判断：\n")
  
  if(n_divergent == 0 &&
     max_rhat < rhat_threshold &&
     max_hyper_rhat < rhat_threshold &&
     min_ess >= ess_threshold) {
    
    cat("🏆 模型采样质量优秀，可放心汇报\n")
    
  } else if(n_divergent == 0 &&
            max_rhat < rhat_max_threshold) {
    
    cat("👍 基本可接受，如用于论文建议略微优化\n")
    
  } else {
    
    cat("🚨 不建议用于正式报告，需重新参数化或调参\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n=====================================\n")
}


begin_id = 1
end_id = 1
for (i in begin_id:end_id) {
  output_file <- paste0("model_ascertain_",  i, "_EXP3_output_260315.Rdata")
  print(paste0("model_", i))
  
  load(file = paste0(result_dir, output_file))
  check_convergence_phd(model_output)
}
```

```{r}

# 准备Stan数据
data_df$SubID_stan <- as.integer(as.factor(data_df$SubID))
data_df$PE_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(data_df$PE))
data_df$outcome_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(data_df$Value))

stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(data_df),
  S = n_subjects,
  subject = data_df$SubID_stan,
  x = data_df$PE_scaled,
  y = data_df$alloc_var,
  outcome = data_df$outcome_scaled,

```

```{r}
#Model weights
output_file <- paste0("model_ascertain_EXP3_2_output_260410.Rdata")
load(file = paste0(result_dir, output_file))
# ==========================================
# 1. 提取基础数据
# ==========================================
# 真实行为数据 (一维向量，长度为 2477)
y_real <- stan_data$y

# 提取 Stan 模型生成的预测数据 y_rep 
# 维度应为二维矩阵：[采样次数(如8000), 试次数(2477)]
y_pred_samples <- rstan::extract(model_output)$y_rep 

# 计算每个 trial 在所有 MCMC 采样中的“后验预测均值” (长度为 2477)
y_pred_mean <- colMeans(y_pred_samples)

# 将长格式数据拼成一个方便操作的数据框
dat_ppc <- tibble(
  subject = stan_data$subject,
  y_true  = y_real,
  y_pred  = y_pred_mean
)
```

## Grand Average Scale
```{r}

# ==========================================
# 1. 绘图与保存配置参数区
# ==========================================
# 文件保存设置
file_name     <- ".\\04_pic\\PPC_grand_average_260421.svg"
output_width  <- 8
output_height <- 8
output_units  <- "in"

# 后验抽样与颜色设置
n_draws       <- 100               # 随机抽取的 MCMC 迭代次数 (默认100次以防止图太拥挤)
ppc_color     <- "blue"            # bayesplot 主题色 (可选: "blue", "red", "green", "darkgray", "teal")

# 坐标轴限制 (屏蔽极端异常值)
x_min         <- -50                 
x_max         <- 60               

# 文本标签设置
label_title   <- "Grand-wise PPC"
label_x       <- "ΔAllocation" # 根据你的因变量含义修改
label_y       <- "Density"

# 全局字体排版设置
base_font_size  <- 30
title_font_size <- 30

# ==========================================
# 2. 核心绘图代码
# ==========================================


# 【关键点】设置 bayesplot 专用的颜色主题
color_scheme_set(ppc_color)

# 生成密度叠加图 (从几千次抽样中随机抽取 n_draws 次)
p_grand <- ppc_dens_overlay(
  y = y_real, 
  yrep = y_pred_samples[sample(1:nrow(y_pred_samples), n_draws), ]
) +
  # 截断 X 轴，看清主体分布
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, x_max)) + 
  
  # 标题与坐标轴标签
  labs(title = label_title,
       x = label_x,
       y = label_y) +
  
  # 主题与字体大小应用
  theme_bw(base_size = base_font_size) +
  
  # 细节精修
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = title_font_size),
    axis.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = title_font_size),
    axis.text  = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.85),  # 将图例(y vs yrep)移到顶部，为数据展示留出更多横向空间
    #legend.text = element_text(size = 180, face = "bold"),
    # 增大图例字体（对应你之前的需求）
      # 1. 真正增大文字字体（单位是 pts）
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18), 
    
    # 2. 真正增大图例标题字体
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    
    # 3. 配合增大图标的大小（否则大字配小方块会很难看）
    legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "lines"), 
    
    # 4. 如果文字变大后互相重叠，可以增加条目之间的垂直间距
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "cm")
  )

# 显示图像
print(p_grand)

# ==========================================
# 3. 执行保存
# ==========================================
ggsave(filename = file_name, plot = p_grand, width = output_width, height = output_height, units = output_units)
```

```{r}
# 步骤 (a): 设定组级真实参数 (从先验空间随机抽取)
true_mu_epsilon <- rnorm(1, 0, 5) # 假设随机抽到一个合理的值
true_sigma_epsilon <- abs(rnorm(1, 0, 5))

# 步骤 (b): 模拟 80 名合成参与者的个体级参数
N_sim <- 80
T_sim <- 66
true_epsilon_ind <- rnorm(N_sim, true_mu_epsilon, true_sigma_epsilon)

# 步骤 (c): 使用生成模型（似然函数）模拟行为数据
# 这里需要你用 R 写一个与 Stan 模型一致的数据生成函数
simulate_data <- function(epsilon, trials) {
  # [这里是你的认知模型核心逻辑，例如 Softmax/Drift Diffusion等]
  # 返回一个长度为 trials 的向量
  # 示例：简单二项分布
  prob <- 1 / (1 + exp(-epsilon)) 
  return(rbinom(trials, 1, prob))
}

simulated_choice <- matrix(NA, nrow = N_sim, ncol = T_sim)
for (i in 1:N_sim) {
  simulated_choice[i, ] <- simulate_data(true_epsilon_ind[i], T_sim)
}

# 步骤 (d): 重新拟合生成的数据
sim_stan_data <- list(N = N_sim, T = T_sim, choice = simulated_choice)
fit_sim <- stan(file = "winning_model.stan", data = sim_stan_data, 
                chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, cores = 4)

# 步骤 (e): 比较真实值与后验估计值
# 提取个体级参数的后验均值
est_epsilon_ind <- summary(fit_sim, pars = "epsilon")$summary[, "mean"]

# 绘制参数恢复图
ggplot(data.frame(True = true_epsilon_ind, Estimated = est_epsilon_ind), aes(x = True, y = Estimated)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "blue", size = 3) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  ggtitle("Parameter Recovery: True vs. Estimated Individual Parameters") +
  xlab("True Parameters (Generating)") +
  ylab("Estimated Parameters (Posterior Mean)") +
  theme_bw()

# 计算恢复的 Pearson 相关系数
cat("Parameter Recovery Correlation:", cor(true_epsilon_ind, est_epsilon_ind), "\n")
```

# Parameter recovery

```{r}

library(rstan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# =========================
# 1. Simulate data
# =========================
simulate_data <- function(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 60, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  true_hyper <- list(
    mu_int_neg = -0.74, sigma_int_neg = 3,
    mu_int_pos = 4.70, sigma_int_pos = 4,
    mu_slo_neg = 3.08, sigma_slo_neg = 1,
    mu_slo_pos = 3.37, sigma_slo_pos = 1,
    sigma_obs  = 2,
    nu = 4
  )
  
  z_int_neg <- rnorm(S)
  z_int_pos <- rnorm(S)
  z_slo_neg <- rnorm(S)
  z_slo_pos <- rnorm(S)
  
  int_neg <- true_hyper$mu_int_neg + true_hyper$sigma_int_neg * z_int_neg
  int_pos <- true_hyper$mu_int_pos + true_hyper$sigma_int_pos * z_int_pos
  
  # 斜率不做 exp()，允许为负
  slo_neg <- true_hyper$mu_slo_neg + true_hyper$sigma_slo_neg * z_slo_neg
  slo_pos <- true_hyper$mu_slo_pos + true_hyper$sigma_slo_pos * z_slo_pos
  
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  x <- rnorm(N, 0, 1)
  y <- numeric(N)
  
  for (i in 1:N) {
    s <- subject[i]
    
    mu <- ifelse(
      x[i] < 0,
      int_neg[s] + slo_neg[s] * x[i],
      int_pos[s] + slo_pos[s] * x[i]
    )
    
    y[i] <- mu + true_hyper$sigma_obs * rt(1, df = true_hyper$nu)
  }
  
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 50), -50)
  
  true_ind <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    int_neg = int_neg,
    int_pos = int_pos,
    slo_neg = slo_neg,
    slo_pos = slo_pos
  )
  
  list(
    stan_data = list(
      N = N,
      S = S,
      subject = subject,
      x = x,
      y = y
    ),
    true_hyper = true_hyper,
    true_ind = true_ind
  )
}

# =========================
# 2. Fit Stan model
# =========================
sim <- simulate_data(
  S = 43,
  trials_per_subj = 60,
  seed = 123
)

fit_recovery <- stan(
  file = "model_ascertain_2_260402.stan",
  data = sim$stan_data,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 42
)

# =========================
# 3. Extract recovered parameters
# =========================
post <- rstan::extract(fit_recovery)

rec_ind <- data.frame(
  subject = 1:sim$stan_data$S,
  int_neg = colMeans(post$int_neg),
  int_pos = colMeans(post$int_pos),
  slo_neg = colMeans(post$slo_neg),
  slo_pos = colMeans(post$slo_pos)
)

# =========================
# 4. Build recovery dataframe
# =========================
df_recovery <- sim$true_ind %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -subject,
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "true"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    rec_ind %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -subject,
        names_to = "parameter",
        values_to = "recovered"
      ),
    by = c("subject", "parameter")
  )

# =========================
# 5. Recovery correlation
# =========================

# 每个参数各自的 recovery r
recovery_by_param <- df_recovery %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(true, recovered),
    p = cor.test(true, recovered)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(recovery_by_param)

# 所有参数拼接后的 overall recovery r
overall_test <- cor.test(
  df_recovery$true,
  df_recovery$recovered
)

cat("\nOverall parameter recovery:\n")
cat("r =", round(overall_test$estimate, 3), "\n")
cat("95% CI = [",
    round(overall_test$conf.int[1], 3), ", ",
    round(overall_test$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
cat("t(", overall_test$parameter, ") = ",
    round(overall_test$statistic, 3), "\n", sep = "")
cat("p =", signif(overall_test$p.value, 3), "\n")

# =========================
# 6. Simple recovery plot
# =========================
p_recovery <- ggplot(
  df_recovery,
  aes(x = true, y = recovered)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Parameter recovery: overall r = ",
      round(overall_test$estimate, 2)
    ),
    x = "True parameter",
    y = "Recovered posterior mean"
  )

print(p_recovery)

```

```{r}

# ==========================================
# 步骤 1: 构建数据生成器
# ==========================================
simulate_data <- function(S = 40, trials_per_subj = 60, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平超参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # 这些值是你希望模型最终能找回来的“上帝视角”真实值
  true_params <- list(
    mu_int_neg = -5.0,  sigma_int_neg = 3.0,
    mu_int_pos =  5.0,  sigma_int_pos = 4.0,
    # 注意：斜率的 mu 是在 log 尺度上的，exp(0.5) 约为 1.6
    mu_slo_neg =  0.5,  sigma_slo_neg = 0.2, 
    mu_slo_pos =  0.8,  sigma_slo_pos = 0.3,
    sigma_obs  =  8.0,  # 观测噪声
    nu         =  4.0   # Student-t 的自由度，越小尾巴越厚
  )
  
  # 2. 模拟个体水平参数 (使用非中心参数化逻辑)
  # 生成标准正态分布的扰动项 z
  z_int_neg <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  z_int_pos <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  z_slo_neg <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  z_slo_pos <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数 (严格对齐 transformed parameters 模块)
  # 截距是线性组合
  int_neg <- true_params$mu_int_neg + true_params$sigma_int_neg * z_int_neg
  int_pos <- true_params$mu_int_pos + true_params$sigma_int_pos * z_int_pos
  # 斜率带有 exp() 转换保证大于 0
  slo_neg <- true_params$mu_slo_neg + true_params$sigma_slo_neg * z_slo_neg
  slo_pos <- true_params$mu_slo_pos + true_params$sigma_slo_pos * z_slo_pos
  
  # 3. 生成实验设计和行为数据
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  x <- rnorm(N, 0, 1) # 生成标准化的 x 变量
  y <- numeric(N)
  
  # 逐 trial 生成数据
  for (i in 1:N) {
    s <- subject[i]
    
    # 核心分段逻辑
    if (x[i] < 0) {
      mu_gen <- int_neg[s] + slo_neg[s] * x[i]
    } else {
      mu_gen <- int_pos[s] + slo_pos[s] * x[i]
    }
    
    # 加入 Student-t 噪声
    # R 语言的 rt() 生成的是标准 t 分布，需要乘以尺度参数并加上位置参数
    y[i] <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(1, df = true_params$nu)
  }
  
  # 根据你的 Stan 代码注释，y 的范围被截断在 [-50, 50]
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 50), -50)
  
  # 将真实的个体参数打包，用于后续核对
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    int_neg = int_neg, int_pos = int_pos,
    slo_neg = slo_neg, slo_pos = slo_pos
  )
  
  # 返回生成的数据和真实参数
  return(list(
    stan_data = list(N = N, S = S, subject = subject, x = x, y = y),
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind = true_ind_params
  ))
}

# ==========================================
# 步骤 2: 拟合模型
# ==========================================
# 生成虚拟数据 (比如 40 个人，每人 60 个 trial)
sim_output <- simulate_data(S = 40, trials_per_subj = 60)

# 调用 rstan 拟合你写好的 stan 模型 (假设文件名为 piecewise_model.stan)
fit_recovery <- stan(
  file = "model_ascertain_2_260402.stan", 
  data = sim_output$stan_data,
  chains = 4, 
  iter = 2000, 
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 42 # 固定种子，保证结果可复现
)

# ==========================================
# 步骤 3: 提取后验并可视化
# ==========================================
# 从模型中提取后验样本
post_samples <- rstan::extract(fit_recovery)

# --- 1. 检查个体水平参数恢复 (散点图) ---
# 提取后验均值
est_int_neg <- colMeans(post_samples$int_neg)
est_int_pos <- colMeans(post_samples$int_pos)
est_slo_neg <- colMeans(post_samples$slo_neg)
est_slo_pos <- colMeans(post_samples$slo_pos)

# 组合成数据框
df_ind_recovery <- data.frame(
  True = c(sim_output$true_ind$int_neg, sim_output$true_ind$int_pos, 
           sim_output$true_ind$slo_neg, sim_output$true_ind$slo_pos),
  Estimated = c(est_int_neg, est_int_pos, est_slo_neg, est_slo_pos),
  Parameter = factor(rep(c("Intercept (x < 0)", "Intercept (x >= 0)", 
                           "Slope (x < 0)", "Slope (x >= 0)"), 
                         each = sim_output$stan_data$S))
)

# 画个体水平散点图
p_ind <- ggplot(df_ind_recovery, aes(x = True, y = Estimated, color = Parameter)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Individual-level Parameter Recovery",
       x = "True Generated Value", y = "Estimated Posterior Mean") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_ind)

# --- 2. 检查群体水平参数恢复 (后验分布图) ---
# 检查这四个核心群体均值
hyper_params_to_check <- c("mu_int_neg", "mu_int_pos", "mu_slo_neg", "mu_slo_pos")

plot_list <- list()
for (param in hyper_params_to_check) {
  
  # 提取真实值和后验分布
  true_val <- sim_output$true_hyper[[param]]
  post_dist <- post_samples[[param]]
  
  # 计算 95% 贝叶斯置信区间 (HDI)
  hdi_lower <- quantile(post_dist, 0.025)
  hdi_upper <- quantile(post_dist, 0.975)
  
  # 画密度图
  plot_list[[param]] <- ggplot(data.frame(x = post_dist), aes(x = x)) +
    geom_density(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = true_val, color = "red", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(hdi_lower, hdi_upper), color = "gray40", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = param, x = "Posterior Estimate", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal()
}

# 拼图并展示群体参数恢复
p_group <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Group-level Hyperparameter Recovery",
                  subtitle = "Red line = True Value, Dashed lines = 95% CrI")
print(p_group)
```

# Model Recovery
```{r}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0. 路径设置 (请确保路径正确)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stan_dir <- "E:\\lxq\\analysis\\2026winter\\rstan_model\\"
result_dir <- paste0(stan_dir, "03_model_recovery\\")
if (!dir.exists(result_dir)) {
  dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 定义你要参与模型恢复的模型编号 
# ---------------------------------------------------------
target_models <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 17, 18) 
n_datasets_per_model <- 10        # 每个模型生成几套虚拟数据 

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 占位：数据生成函数的分发器
# ---------------------------------------------------------
generate_sim_data <- function(model_id, S = 43, trials = 60, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  if (model_id == 1) {
    return(simulate_data_model1(S, trials))
  } else if (model_id == 2) {
    return(simulate_data_model2(S, trials))
  } else if (model_id == 3) {
    return(simulate_data_model3(S, trials))
  } else if (model_id == 4) {
    return(simulate_data_model4(S, trials))
  } else if (model_id == 9) {
    return(simulate_data_model9(S, trials))
  } else if (model_id == 10) {
    return(simulate_data_model10(S, trials))
  } else if (model_id == 17) {
    return(simulate_data_model17(S, trials))
  } else if (model_id == 20) {
    return(simulate_data_model20(S, trials))
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 核心双重循环：生成数据 -> 交叉拟合
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 记录结果的大表
recovery_results <- data.frame()

for (gen_id in target_models) {
  cat(sprintf("\n🚀 开始使用模型 %d 生成数据...\n", gen_id))
  
  for (dataset_idx in 1:n_datasets_per_model) {
    cat(sprintf("   -> 正在处理第 %d/%d 套数据集\n", dataset_idx, n_datasets_per_model))
    
    # a. 生成虚拟数据
    # 为了保证每套数据集都不一样，传入动态的 seed
    sim_data <- generate_sim_data(gen_id, S = 43, trials = 57, seed = gen_id * 1000 + dataset_idx) 
    
    # 【新增】：保存生成的虚拟数据和真实参数，用于后续参数恢复比对
    sim_file <- sprintf("%s/SimData_genM%d_dataset%d.rds", result_dir, gen_id, dataset_idx)
    saveRDS(sim_data, file = sim_file)
    
    # 临时存储这套数据集下，各个拟合模型的 LOOIC
    loo_scores <- numeric(length(target_models))
    names(loo_scores) <- paste0("Fit_", target_models)
    
    # b. 用所有候选模型去拟合这套虚拟数据
    for (fit_idx in 1:length(target_models)) {
      fit_id <- target_models[fit_idx]
      model_file <- paste0("model_ascertain_", fit_id, "_260402.stan") 
      
      cat(sprintf("      拟合模型 %d ... ", fit_id))
      
      # 使用 tryCatch 防止报错中断循环
      fit_result <- tryCatch({
        stan(
          file = file.path(stan_dir, model_file),
          data = sim_data$stan_data,  # 【关键修正】：提取列表中的 stan_data 喂给模型
          chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, cores = 4,
          control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
          refresh = 0 
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("❌ 失败! 错误信息:", e$message, "\n")
        return(NULL)
      })
      
      # c. 提取 LOOIC 并保存关键参数
      if (!is.null(fit_result)) {
        
        # 1. 提取 LOOIC
        log_lik <- extract_log_lik(fit_result, merge_chains = FALSE)
        r_eff <- relative_eff(exp(log_lik), cores = 4)
        loo_res <- loo(log_lik, r_eff = r_eff)
        loo_scores[fit_idx] <- loo_res$estimates["looic", "Estimate"]
        
        # 2. 提取参数摘要（智能过滤掉 y_rep 和 log_lik，极大节省空间）
        all_pars <- fit_result@model_pars
        keep_pars <- all_pars[!grepl("^(y_rep|log_lik)", all_pars)] 
        param_summary <- summary(fit_result, pars = keep_pars)$summary
        
        # 3. 打包并保存关键数据到硬盘
        key_data <- list(
          generating_model = gen_id,
          fitted_model = fit_id,
          dataset_id = dataset_idx,
          looic_score = loo_scores[fit_idx],
          loo_object = loo_res,       
          param_summary = param_summary 
        )
        key_file <- sprintf("%s/KeyData_genM%d_fitM%d_dataset%d.rds", result_dir, gen_id, fit_id, dataset_idx)
        saveRDS(key_data, file = key_file)
        
        cat("✅ 完成 (LOOIC:", round(loo_scores[fit_idx], 1), ")\n")
        
        # 清理内存，防止溢出
        rm(fit_result, log_lik, r_eff, loo_res, param_summary, key_data)
        gc()
      } else {
        loo_scores[fit_idx] <- NA # 拟合失败记为 NA
      }
    }
    
    # d. 找出 LOOIC 最小（表现最好）的模型
    best_fit_idx <- which.min(loo_scores)
    best_fit_id <- target_models[best_fit_idx]
    
    # e. 记录这一轮的结果
    current_res <- data.frame(
      Dataset_ID = dataset_idx,
      Generating_Model = paste0("M", gen_id),
      Best_Fitting_Model = paste0("M", best_fit_id)
    )
    # 把所有拟合的 LOOIC 也存下来
    for(k in 1:length(target_models)) {
      current_res[[paste0("LOOIC_M", target_models[k])]] <- loo_scores[k]
    }
    
    recovery_results <- bind_rows(recovery_results, current_res)
    
    # f. 【核心保险】每跑完一套数据集，立刻存盘
    write.csv(recovery_results, 
              file = file.path(result_dir, "model_recovery_temp_results.csv"), 
              row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

cat("\n🎉 全部模型恢复运行完毕！\n")
```

## Model-1
```{r}

simulate_data_model1 <- function(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 57, seed = 123) {
  # 固定随机种子
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # ========================================================
  true_params <- list(
    mu_int =  5.0,   # 截距的群体均值
    mu_slo =  2.0,   # 斜率的群体均值 (这里没有 exp，直接是线性斜率)
    
    sigma_int = 4.0, # 截距的群体标准差
    sigma_slo = 1.5, # 斜率的群体标准差
    
    sigma_obs = 8.0, # 观测噪声尺度
    nu = 4.0         # Student-t 的自由度
  )
  
  # ========================================================
  # 2. 模拟个体参数 (对应 parameters 和 transformed parameters)
  # ========================================================
  # 生成非中心化扰动项 z (标准正态分布)
  z_int <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_slo <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数 (纯线性组合，无 exp 转换)
  inter <- true_params$mu_int + true_params$sigma_int * z_int
  slope <- true_params$mu_slo + true_params$sigma_slo * z_slo
  
  # ========================================================
  # 3. 模拟行为数据 (对应 model 和 generated quantities)
  # ========================================================
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  
  # 生成自变量 x (标准化：均值0，标准差1)
  x <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 【核心修改】：因为没有分段逻辑，这里可以直接使用 R 的向量化计算，无需写 for 循环
  # 这一行完美对应你 Stan 模型中的: vector[N] mu = inter[subject] + slope[subject] .* x;
  mu_gen <- inter[subject] + slope[subject] * x
  
  # 生成 Student-t 噪声
  # rt(N, df) 生成 N 个标准 t 分布的随机数，乘以尺度参数并加上均值
  y <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(N, df = true_params$nu)
  
  # 根据你之前设定的因变量物理意义，依然将其截断在 [-50, 50] 之间
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 50), -50)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 4. 打包输出
  # ========================================================
  # 组装给 Stan 的输入数据
  stan_data <- list(
    N = N,
    S = S,
    subject = subject,
    x = x,
    y = y
  )
  
  # 真实的个体参数表
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    inter = inter, 
    slope = slope
  )
  
  return(list(
    stan_data  = stan_data,
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind   = true_ind_params
  ))
}

# 测试运行

# head(sim_result$stan_data$y)
```

## Model-2
```{r}

simulate_data_model2 <- function(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 57, seed = 123) {
  # 固定随机种子以保证结果可重复
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # ========================================================
  true_params <- list(
    # 截距群体均值
    mu_int_neg = -5.0,  
    mu_int_pos =  5.0,  
    
    # 斜率群体均值 (纯线性斜率)
    mu_slo_neg =  2.0,  
    mu_slo_pos =  1.5,  
    
    # 群体水平标准差
    sigma_int_neg = 4.0,
    sigma_int_pos = 4.0,
    sigma_slo_neg = 1.0,
    sigma_slo_pos = 1.0,
    
    # 观测噪声尺度与 Student-t 自由度
    sigma_obs = 8.0,
    nu = 4.0   # Stan中设了 <lower=2>，所以这里必须 >= 2
  )
  
  # ========================================================
  # 2. 模拟个体参数 (对应 parameters 和 transformed parameters)
  # ========================================================
  # 生成非中心化扰动项 z (标准正态分布)
  z_int_neg <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_int_pos <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_slo_neg <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_slo_pos <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数 (纯线性组合，与 transformed parameters 完全一致)
  int_neg <- true_params$mu_int_neg + true_params$sigma_int_neg * z_int_neg
  int_pos <- true_params$mu_int_pos + true_params$sigma_int_pos * z_int_pos
  slo_neg <- true_params$mu_slo_neg + true_params$sigma_slo_neg * z_slo_neg
  slo_pos <- true_params$mu_slo_pos + true_params$sigma_slo_pos * z_slo_pos
  
  # ========================================================
  # 3. 模拟行为数据 (对应 model 和 generated quantities)
  # ========================================================
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  
  # 生成自变量 x (标准化：均值0，标准差1)
  x <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 【核心逻辑】：使用 ifelse() 完美替代 for 循环，实现极速的分段向量化计算
  # 等效于你 Stan 里的 if (x[n] < 0) { ... } else { ... }
  mu_gen <- ifelse(
    x < 0, 
    int_neg[subject] + slo_neg[subject] * x,  # x < 0 时的期望值
    int_pos[subject] + slo_pos[subject] * x   # x >= 0 时的期望值
  )
  
  # 生成 Student-t 噪声
  # R 语言里的 rt() 是标准 t 分布，必须乘以尺度参数 (sigma_obs) 并加上均值 (mu_gen)
  y <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(N, df = true_params$nu)
  
  # 将因变量强行截断在 [-50, 50] 之间，防止越界
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 50), -50)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 4. 打包输出
  # ========================================================
  # 组装给 Stan 的输入数据
  stan_data <- list(
    N = N,
    S = S,
    subject = subject,
    x = x,
    y = y
  )
  
  # 将真实的个体参数也存下来，方便做参数恢复的散点图核对
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    int_neg = int_neg, 
    int_pos = int_pos,
    slo_neg = slo_neg, 
    slo_pos = slo_pos
  )
  
  # 返回结果
  return(list(
    stan_data  = stan_data,
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind   = true_ind_params
  ))
}

# 测试代码 (可以去掉注释运行看看)
```

## Model-3
```{r}

simulate_data_model3 <- function(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 57, seed = 123) {
  # 固定随机种子，保证每次生成结果一致
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # ========================================================
  true_params <- list(
    # 截距群体均值 (因为 y 范围是 -50 到 50，截距设在 0 附近比较合理)
    mu_int = 5.0,  
    
    # 斜率群体均值 (注意：Stan模型里经过了 exp() 转换，所以这里是对数尺度)
    # 设定为 0.5，实际的群体平均斜率约为 exp(0.5) ≈ 1.65
    mu_slo_neg = 0.5,  
    mu_slo_pos = 0.2,  
    
    # 群体水平标准差
    sigma_int = 5.0,
    sigma_slo_neg = 0.2,
    sigma_slo_pos = 0.2,
    
    # 观测噪声与 Student-t 自由度
    sigma_obs = 8.0,
    nu = 4.0   # 自由度 <lower=1>，设为 4 具有较厚尾部
  )
  
  # ========================================================
  # 2. 模拟个体参数 (对应 parameters 和 transformed parameters)
  # ========================================================
  # 生成非中心化扰动项 z (标准正态分布)
  z_int <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_slo_neg <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_slo_pos <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数
  # 截距是纯线性组合
  inter <- true_params$mu_int + true_params$sigma_int * z_int
  
  # 斜率必须加上 exp() 转换，与 Stan 模型的 <lower=0> 和 exp(...) 绝对对齐
  slo_neg <- exp(true_params$mu_slo_neg + true_params$sigma_slo_neg * z_slo_neg)
  slo_pos <- exp(true_params$mu_slo_pos + true_params$sigma_slo_pos * z_slo_pos)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 3. 模拟行为数据 (对应 model 和 generated quantities)
  # ========================================================
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  
  # 生成自变量 x (标准化：均值0，标准差1)
  x <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 【核心向量化】：使用 ifelse 完美替代 for 循环，区分 x 的正负侧
  # 注意：两侧调用的都是统一的 inter[subject]
  mu_gen <- ifelse(
    x < 0, 
    inter[subject] + slo_neg[subject] * x,  
    inter[subject] + slo_pos[subject] * x   
  )
  
  # 生成 Student-t 噪声并加到期望值上
  # R中的 rt(N, df) 是标准 t 分布，必须乘以尺度参数 (sigma_obs) 并加上位置参数 (mu_gen)
  y <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(N, df = true_params$nu)
  
  # 根据数据块的注释，将 y 强行截断在 [-50, 50] 之间
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 50), -50)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 4. 打包输出
  # ========================================================
  stan_data <- list(
    N = N,
    S = S,
    subject = subject,
    x = x,
    y = y
  )
  
  # 真实的个体参数表，留作后续画图对比
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    inter = inter, 
    slo_neg = slo_neg, 
    slo_pos = slo_pos
  )
  
  return(list(
    stan_data  = stan_data,
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind   = true_ind_params
  ))
}
```

## Model-4
```{r}

simulate_data_model4 <- function(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 57, seed = 123) {
  # 固定随机种子，保证每次生成的结果一致
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # ========================================================
  true_params <- list(
    # 分段截距群体均值 (设定在 0-100 的合理范围内，比如 40 和 60)
    mu_int_neg = 2.0,  
    mu_int_pos = 5.0,  
    
    # 统一斜率群体均值 
    # 注意：Stan 里你给了 lognormal(0, 1) 先验，所以它不仅本身要 > 0，而且还要被 exp() 转换。
    # 设定为 0.5 时，实际群体平均斜率为 exp(0.5) ≈ 1.65
    mu_slo = 0.5,  
    
    # 群体水平标准差
    sigma_int_neg = 5.0,
    sigma_int_pos = 5.0,
    sigma_slo = 0.2,
    
    # 观测噪声与 Student-t 自由度
    sigma_obs = 8.0,
    nu = 4.0   # 自由度 <lower=1>，设为 4 具有较厚尾部
  )
  
  # ========================================================
  # 2. 模拟个体参数 (对应 parameters 和 transformed parameters)
  # ========================================================
  # 生成非中心化扰动项 z (标准正态分布)
  z_int_neg <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_int_pos <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_slo     <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数
  # 截距是纯线性组合
  int_neg <- true_params$mu_int_neg + true_params$sigma_int_neg * z_int_neg
  int_pos <- true_params$mu_int_pos + true_params$sigma_int_pos * z_int_pos
  
  # 统一斜率必须加上 exp() 转换
  slo <- exp(true_params$mu_slo + true_params$sigma_slo * z_slo)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 3. 模拟行为数据 (对应 model 和 generated quantities)
  # ========================================================
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  
  # 生成自变量 x (标准化：均值0，标准差1)
  x <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 【核心向量化】：使用 ifelse 区分 x 的正负侧
  # 注意：两侧现在调用的是同一个斜率 slo[subject]
  mu_gen <- ifelse(
    x < 0, 
    int_neg[subject] + slo[subject] * x,  
    int_pos[subject] + slo[subject] * x   
  )
  
  # 生成 Student-t 噪声并加到期望值上
  y <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(N, df = true_params$nu)
  
  # 根据数据块的注释，将 y 强行截断在 [0, 100] 之间
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 100), 0)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 4. 打包输出
  # ========================================================
  stan_data <- list(
    N = N,
    S = S,
    subject = subject,
    x = x,
    y = y
  )
  
  # 真实的个体参数表，留作参数恢复对比图使用
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    int_neg = int_neg, 
    int_pos = int_pos,
    slo     = slo
  )
  
  return(list(
    stan_data  = stan_data,
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind   = true_ind_params
  ))
}
```

## Model-9
```{r}

simulate_data_model9 <- function(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 57, seed = 123) {
  # 固定随机种子
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # ========================================================
  true_params <- list(
    # 统一斜率群体均值 (对数尺度)
    # 设定为 0.5 时，实际的群体平均斜率约为 exp(0.5) ≈ 1.65
    mu_slo = 0.5,  
    
    # 群体水平标准差
    sigma_slo = 0.2,
    
    # 观测噪声与 Student-t 自由度
    sigma_obs = 8.0,
    nu = 4.0   # 自由度 <lower=1>
  )
  
  # ========================================================
  # 2. 模拟个体参数 (对应 parameters 和 transformed parameters)
  # ========================================================
  # 生成非中心化扰动项 z (标准正态分布)
  z_slo <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数
  # 【注意】：此模型去掉了截距变量，仅有加了 exp() 转换的个体斜率
  slope <- exp(true_params$mu_slo + true_params$sigma_slo * z_slo)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 3. 模拟行为数据 (对应 model 和 generated quantities)
  # ========================================================
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  
  # 生成自变量 x (标准化：均值0，标准差1)
  x <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 【核心向量化】：无截距、无分段，直接用个体斜率乘以 x
  mu_gen <- slope[subject] * x
  
  # 生成 Student-t 噪声并加到期望值上
  y <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(N, df = true_params$nu)
  
  # （可选）由于你这次的代码中未写明 y 的具体上下限范围
  # 如果实际物理意义上有边界，请取消下面代码的注释并修改数值：
  # y <- pmax(pmin(y, 100), 0)   # 限制在 0-100
  # y <- pmax(pmin(y, 50), -50)  # 限制在 -50-50
  
  # ========================================================
  # 4. 打包输出
  # ========================================================
  stan_data <- list(
    N = N,
    S = S,
    subject = subject,
    x = x,
    y = y
  )
  
  # 真实的个体参数表
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    slope   = slope
  )
  
  return(list(
    stan_data  = stan_data,
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind   = true_ind_params
  ))
}
```

## Model-10
```{r}

simulate_data_model10 <- function(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 57, seed = 123) {
  # 固定随机种子
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # ========================================================
  true_params <- list(
    # 分段斜率群体均值 (对数尺度)
    # 设定为 0.5 时，实际群体平均斜率约为 exp(0.5) ≈ 1.65
    mu_slo_neg = 0.5,  
    mu_slo_pos = 0.2,  
    
    # 群体水平标准差
    sigma_slo_neg = 0.2,
    sigma_slo_pos = 0.2,
    
    # 观测噪声与 Student-t 自由度
    sigma_obs = 8.0,
    nu = 4.0   # 自由度 <lower=1>
  )
  
  # ========================================================
  # 2. 模拟个体参数
  # ========================================================
  # 生成非中心化扰动项 z (标准正态分布)
  z_slo_neg <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_slo_pos <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数
  # 【注】：你在上面提供的 Stan 代码中写的是 exp(mu * sigma * z)，通常非中心化参数是相加的。
  # 为了确保参数恢复的数学逻辑正确，这里 R 脚本采用标准的加法逻辑：exp(mu + sigma * z)
  slo_neg <- exp(true_params$mu_slo_neg + true_params$sigma_slo_neg * z_slo_neg)
  slo_pos <- exp(true_params$mu_slo_pos + true_params$sigma_slo_pos * z_slo_pos)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 3. 模拟行为数据
  # ========================================================
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  
  # 生成自变量 x (标准化：均值0，标准差1)
  x <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 【核心向量化】：无截距，分段斜率
  mu_gen <- ifelse(
    x < 0, 
    slo_neg[subject] * x,  
    slo_pos[subject] * x   
  )
  
  # 生成 Student-t 噪声并加到期望值上
  y <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(N, df = true_params$nu)
  
  # 根据模型注释，将 y 强行截断在 [0, 100] 之间
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 100), 0)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 4. 打包输出
  # ========================================================
  stan_data <- list(
    N = N,
    S = S,
    subject = subject,
    x = x,
    y = y
  )
  
  # 真实的个体参数表
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    slo_neg = slo_neg,
    slo_pos = slo_pos
  )
  
  return(list(
    stan_data  = stan_data,
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind   = true_ind_params
  ))
}
```

## Model-17
```{r}

library(dplyr)

simulate_data_17 <- function(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 57, seed = 123) {
  # 固定随机种子
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # ========================================================
  true_params <- list(
    # 统一截距群体均值
    mu_int = 10.0,  
    
    # 分段斜率群体均值 (对数尺度)
    # 设定为 0.5 时，实际群体平均斜率约为 exp(0.5) ≈ 1.65
    mu_slo_neg = 0.5,  
    mu_slo_pos = 0.2,  
    
    # 群体水平标准差
    sigma_int = 3.0,
    sigma_slo_neg = 0.2,
    sigma_slo_pos = 0.2,
    
    # 观测噪声与 Student-t 自由度
    sigma_obs = 8.0,
    nu = 4.0   # 自由度 <lower=1>
  )
  
  # ========================================================
  # 2. 模拟个体参数 
  # ========================================================
  # 生成非中心化扰动项 z (标准正态分布)
  z_int <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_slo_neg <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_slo_pos <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数
  inter <- true_params$mu_int + true_params$sigma_int * z_int
  slo_neg <- exp(true_params$mu_slo_neg + true_params$sigma_slo_neg * z_slo_neg)
  slo_pos <- exp(true_params$mu_slo_pos + true_params$sigma_slo_pos * z_slo_pos)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 3. 模拟行为数据 
  # ========================================================
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  
  # 生成自变量 x (标准化：均值0，标准差1)
  x <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 【核心向量化】：严格对齐你模型中的特殊加减法逻辑
  # x < 0 时：斜率 * x - 截距
  # x >= 0 时：斜率 * x + 截距
  mu_gen <- ifelse(
    x < 0, 
    slo_neg[subject] * x - inter[subject],  
    slo_pos[subject] * x + inter[subject]   
  )
  
  # 生成 Student-t 噪声并加到期望值上
  y <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(N, df = true_params$nu)
  
  # 将因变量强行截断在 [-50, 50] 之间
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 50), -50)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 4. 打包输出
  # ========================================================
  stan_data <- list(
    N = N,
    S = S,
    subject = subject,
    x = x,
    y = y
  )
  
  # 真实的个体参数表
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    inter = inter,
    slo_neg = slo_neg,
    slo_pos = slo_pos
  )
  
  return(list(
    stan_data  = stan_data,
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind   = true_ind_params
  ))
}
```

```{r}
simulate_data_model20 <- function(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 57, seed = 123) {
  # 固定随机种子
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # ========================================================
  true_params <- list(
    # 统一截距群体均值 (控制原点处的跳跃幅度)
    mu_int = 10.0,  
    
    # 统一斜率群体均值 (纯线性，无 exp 转换)
    mu_slo = 2.0,  
    
    # 群体水平标准差
    sigma_int = 3.0,
    sigma_slo = 0.5,
    
    # 观测噪声与 Student-t 自由度
    sigma_obs = 8.0,
    nu = 4.0   # 自由度 <lower=1>
  )
  
  # ========================================================
  # 2. 模拟个体参数 
  # ========================================================
  # 生成非中心化扰动项 z (标准正态分布)
  z_int <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  z_slo <- rnorm(S, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数 (纯线性组合，与 transformed parameters 一致)
  inter <- true_params$mu_int + true_params$sigma_int * z_int
  slo   <- true_params$mu_slo + true_params$sigma_slo * z_slo
  
  # ========================================================
  # 3. 模拟行为数据 
  # ========================================================
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  
  # 生成自变量 x (标准化：均值0，标准差1)
  x <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  
  # 【核心向量化】：严格对齐你模型中的特殊加减法逻辑
  # x < 0 时：斜率 * x - 截距
  # x >= 0 时：斜率 * x + 截距
  mu_gen <- ifelse(
    x < 0, 
    slo[subject] * x - inter[subject],  
    slo[subject] * x + inter[subject]   
  )
  
  # 生成 Student-t 噪声并加到期望值上
  y <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(N, df = true_params$nu)
  
  # 将因变量强行截断在 [-50, 50] 之间
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 50), -50)
  
  # ========================================================
  # 4. 打包输出
  # ========================================================
  stan_data <- list(
    N = N,
    S = S,
    subject = subject,
    x = x,
    y = y
  )
  
  # 真实的个体参数表
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    inter = inter,
    slo   = slo
  )
  
  return(list(
    stan_data  = stan_data,
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind   = true_ind_params
  ))
}
```

```{r}

# 1. 定义你要读取的 .Rdata 文件列表
# 结合你最初的代码，假设文件命名规则如下：
modelID_begin <- 2
modelID_end <- 2  # 假设你需要提取编号0到12的模型
rdata_files <- paste0(result_dir, "model_ascertain_EXP3_", modelID_begin:modelID_end, "_output_260410.Rdata")
# 如果文件在特定文件夹中，请加上路径，例如：
# rdata_files <- file.path("results", rdata_files)

# 2. 创建一个空列表，用于暂存每次循环提取出的数据框
all_results_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(rdata_files)) {
  current_file <- rdata_files[i]
  
  if (!file.exists(current_file)) next
  message(sprintf("正在提取文件: %s ...", current_file))
  
  load(current_file) 
  
  if (exists("model_output") && inherits(model_output, "stanfit")) {
    
    # 核心改动 1：提取模型中的【所有】参数的 summary
    full_summary <- summary(model_output)$summary
    
    subj_df <- as.data.frame(full_summary) %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "param_raw") %>%
      
      # 核心改动 2：利用正则表达式进行智能过滤
      # 保留包含方括号和数字的行 (如 inter[1], slo_neg[2])
      filter(str_detect(param_raw, "\\[\\d+\\]")) %>% 
      
      # 剔除不需要的数组变量：后验预测 y_rep、对数似然 log_lik、以及个体扰动项 z_
      filter(!str_detect(param_raw, "^(y_rep|log_lik|z_)")) %>% 
      
      mutate(
        source_model = current_file,
        # 提取参数名：匹配方括号前面的所有字母和下划线 (完美支持 slo_neg 这种命名)
        param_type = str_extract(param_raw, "^[a-zA-Z_]+"), 
        # 提取被试ID：提取字符串里的数字
        subject_id = as.integer(str_extract(param_raw, "\\d+")) 
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(source_model, subject_id, param_type, param_raw, 
             mean, sd, `2.5%`, `50%`, `97.5%`, n_eff, Rhat)
    
    all_results_list[[i]] <- subj_df
    rm(model_output)
    
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("文件 %s 无效。", current_file))
  }
}

# 合并并导出
final_results_df <- bind_rows(all_results_list)
write_csv(final_results_df, file = "param_model2_EXP3_260410.csv")

message("🎉 提取全部完成！结果已保存至: ", output_csv_name)
```

```{r}

modelID_begin <- 2
modelID_end <- 2  # 假设你需要提取编号0到12的模型
rdata_files <- paste0(result_dir, "model_ascertain_EXP3_", modelID_begin:modelID_end, "_output_260410.Rdata")

for (i in seq_along(rdata_files)) {
  current_file <- rdata_files[i]
  
  if (!file.exists(current_file)) next
  message(sprintf("正在提取文件: %s ...", current_file))
  
  load(current_file) 
  # 1. 提取原始（对数）尺度下的群体参数
  
  # 第一步：把模型结果转为纯数据框，规避一切格式报错
  samples_df <- as.data.frame(model_output)

  # 确保你已经把模型结果转为了数据框（如果没有，请取消下面这行的注释）
  # samples_df <- as.data.frame(model_output)
  
  # ==========================================
  # 1. 自动抓取四个指标下，所有个体的列名
  # ==========================================
  # 注意：你的模型中个体参数叫 int_neg, int_pos, slo_neg, slo_pos
  cols_int_neg <- grep("^int_neg\\[", colnames(samples_df), value = TRUE)
  cols_int_pos <- grep("^int_pos\\[", colnames(samples_df), value = TRUE)
  cols_slo_neg <- grep("^slo_neg\\[", colnames(samples_df), value = TRUE)
  cols_slo_pos <- grep("^slo_pos\\[", colnames(samples_df), value = TRUE)
  
  # ==========================================
  # 2. 计算“个体算术平均值”的后验分布
  # ==========================================
  # rowMeans 会在每一次抽样（每一行）中，算出所有被试的平均值
  dist_mean_int_neg <- rowMeans(samples_df[, cols_int_neg])
  dist_mean_int_pos <- rowMeans(samples_df[, cols_int_pos])
  dist_mean_slo_neg <- rowMeans(samples_df[, cols_slo_neg])
  dist_mean_slo_pos <- rowMeans(samples_df[, cols_slo_pos])
  
  # ==========================================
  # 3. 定义汇总函数（算均值和 95% HDI）
  # ==========================================
  get_empirical_summary <- function(dist_data, param_name) {
    # 算分布的均值
    val_mean <- mean(dist_data)
    # 算分布的 95% HDI
    val_hdi <- hdi(dist_data, credMass = 0.95)
    
    # 拼成一行
    data.frame(
      Parameter = param_name,
      Arithmetic_Mean = round(val_mean, 3), # 这个就是你看到的 3.几
      HDI_2.5 = round(val_hdi[1], 3),
      HDI_97.5 = round(val_hdi[2], 3)
    )
  }
  
  # ==========================================
  # 4. 生成最终报告表格
  # ==========================================
  final_empirical_table <- rbind(
    get_empirical_summary(dist_mean_int_neg, "实际个体算术平均_截距 (x < 0)"),
    get_empirical_summary(dist_mean_int_pos, "实际个体算术平均_截距 (x >= 0)"),
    get_empirical_summary(dist_mean_slo_neg, "实际个体算术平均_物理斜率 (x < 0)"),
    get_empirical_summary(dist_mean_slo_pos, "实际个体算术平均_物理斜率 (x >= 0)")
  )
  
  # 打印最终表格，去掉行名让它更干净
  rownames(final_empirical_table) <- NULL
  print(final_empirical_table)
}
```

```{r}
# 4. 循环处理每个模型
# 使用 seq_along 确保我们可以通过索引重命名
for (i in seq_along(file_paths)) {
  
  # a. 创建临时环境以防变量名冲突
  temp_env <- new.env()
  
  # b. 加载当前文件
  cat("正在处理第", i, "个模型:", basename(file_paths[i]), "\n")
  load(file_paths[i], envir = temp_env)
  
  # c. 提取模型对象 (假设对象在里面都叫 model_output)
  fit_obj <- temp_env$model_output
  
  # d. 计算 PSIS-LOO (核心指标)
  # cores = 4 可以根据你的电脑 CPU 核数调整，加快速度
  # save_psis = TRUE 有助于后续可能的诊断
  current_loo <- loo(fit_obj, cores = 4)
  
  # e. 将计算好的 loo 结果存入列表，并以文件名命名
  model_name <- gsub("\\.Rdata$", "", basename(file_paths[i]))
  loo_list[[model_name]] <- current_loo
  
  # f. 关键步骤：显式清理内存，防止加载 12 个模型后内存溢出
  rm(fit_obj, temp_env)
  gc() # 强制进行垃圾回收
}

# 5. 计算 BMA-BB 权重 (Bayesian Model Averaging via Bayesian Bootstrap)
# method = "pseudobma" 结合 BB = TRUE 即为你论文中要求的算法
set.seed(123) # 因为 Bayesian Bootstrap 涉及随机采样，设置随机种子保证结果可重复
model_weights <- loo_model_weights(
  loo_list, 
  method = "pseudobma", 
  BB = TRUE, 
  iterations = 1000  # BB 的采样次数，默认 1000 通常足够
)

# 6. 查看并导出结果
print(model_weights)

# 转换为易读的数据框并保存
weight_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(model_weights))
colnames(weight_df) <- "Weight"
weight_df$Model <- rownames(weight_df)
# 按权重从高到低排序
weight_df <- weight_df[order(-weight_df$Weight), ]

print(weight_df)
write.csv(weight_df, "BMA_BB_Weights_Results_EXP3_260329.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```
